label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
Priya,

First: breathe. I’m not throwing you under the bus with Greg. This is a bad miss, not a career-ending thing, and I’m not going to let one stale answer in a library nobody owns become the whole story. You stayed until 9pm in September rebuilding their demo environment when the route import broke—I haven’t forgotten that, and neither should anyone else.

I won’t pretend I’m not stressed. Brazos is $186k ARR over three years, I’ve been working it since February, and it’s my biggest deal this year. I already told my wife we’d finally do the Big Bend trip off this commission, so yeah, I’m feeling it. But that’s on me to manage, not on you.

Here’s the plan. Q14 needs to be corrected tonight with the real Type I status—Type I issued in April, Type II in progress—and the actual Jan 31 audit window close, report expected March. Send the corrected version to me first, not Dana. I’ll review and own the send.

Marcus on our security team can do a call with Dana and their legal Thursday at 2. You need to be on that call with us. He also says we can provide a bridge letter from the auditor, so we’ll walk them through that.

I’ll deal with Greg. He’s going to be mad no matter what, but I’m not going to make this about you personally. The questionnaire library has stale language and no clear owner; that’s the broader issue, and I’ll say so.

Dana seems strict but fair, and I think this is fixable if we’re honest and fast. Corrected Q14 to me tonight, Thursday 2pm on your calendar, and don’t beat yourself up. We’re fixing this together.

Jordan
